fusions.name: Slackening Drift
fusions.desc: Lets a slack cone of thread drift 3.5 tiles ahead, dealing 4 damage to everything caught in it, each with a 30% chance to be [Stalled] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Waterlogged Bundle
fusions.desc: Lobs a waterlogged bundle that deals 12 damage to the first enemy it meets, knocks it back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Enervated] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Tide Tuck
fusions.desc: Settles you in warm wrapping, restoring 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Gentle Swaddle
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 6% and you regenerate 1 health a second, permanently.
